# Heal Before Home

> Heal Before Home (HBH) provides personalized, non-clinical coordination of medical travel, wellness and recovery journeys in the Philippines: planning, accommodation, private transportation, airport assistance, companion arrangements, recovery support, follow-up logistics and the transition home, all arranged around an independent healthcare provider's care plan. HBH is based in British Columbia, Canada, and serves guests travelling from Canada and abroad, as well as guests seeking care locally in the Philippines.

Important: Heal Before Home does not practise medicine. It does not provide medical treatment, diagnoses, clinical advice or medical recommendations, and it does not determine medical suitability. Medical decisions remain between the guest and their licensed healthcare providers. When needed, HBH can facilitate introductions to independent providers for guests to explore directly.

- Founder: Agnes Dalisay, Principal and Founder
- Destinations: Manila, Cebu, Tagaytay, Batangas and Palawan
- Pricing: every journey is quoted individually after an enquiry and introductory conversation; there is no standard package pricing
- Services are available a la carte or as curated packages
- Contact: hello@healbeforehome.com, +1-778-320-0067 (telephone and WhatsApp), https://www.healbeforehome.com/contact
- Social: https://www.instagram.com/healbeforehome, https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61591911984056, https://www.linkedin.com/in/healbeforehome/, https://www.tiktok.com/@healbeforehome

- [The HBH Signature Experience](https://www.healbeforehome.com/recovery-experience): VIP airport assistance, private chauffeur transfers, recovery-focused accommodation, companion arrangements and during-stay support
- [Why the Philippines](https://www.healbeforehome.com/medical-travel-philippines): established private healthcare, English-language fluency and a culture of hospitality
- [Standards & Trust](https://www.healbeforehome.com/standards-trust): how HBH coordinates care and the boundaries of its role
- [FAQ](https://www.healbeforehome.com/faq): what HBH coordinates, what stays with healthcare providers, how partners are vetted, quoting, companions and arrival

## Areas of care

- [Areas of Care](https://www.healbeforehome.com/areas-of-care): all areas of care HBH coordinates journeys around
- [Dental Care](https://www.healbeforehome.com/dental-care): implants, full-arch rehabilitation, veneers, periodontal care, oral and maxillofacial surgery
- [Hair Restoration](https://www.healbeforehome.com/hair-restoration): FUE and DHI hair transplants, non-surgical options and scalp treatments
- [Fertility & Reproductive Care](https://www.healbeforehome.com/fertility-reproductive-care): fertility assessment, IVF, IUI, fertility preservation and reproductive surgery
- [Women's Health & Healthy Aging](https://www.healbeforehome.com/women-s-health-healthy-aging): perimenopause and hormonal health, preventive screening, pelvic and gynecologic care
- [Orthopedics & Spine Care](https://www.healbeforehome.com/orthopedic-care): joint replacement, spine surgery and sports injuries
- [Vision & Ophthalmology](https://www.healbeforehome.com/vision-care): laser vision correction, cataract surgery, glaucoma, retinal and corneal care
- [Aesthetic Surgery, Regenerative & Reconstructive Care](https://www.healbeforehome.com/aesthetic-reconstructive-health): skin health, regenerative therapies, laser treatments, scar revision and selected surgical procedures
- [Stem Cell & Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy](https://www.healbeforehome.com/stem-cell-hyperbaric-oxygen-therapy): independent specialist consultations for regenerative medicine and HBOT
- [Confidence & Transition Coaching](https://www.healbeforehome.com/confidence-transition-coaching): structured coaching before and after selected aesthetic procedures
- [Oncology Second Opinion](https://www.healbeforehome.com/oncology-second-opinion): a virtual second opinion from an independent oncology specialist
